title: MEPST : HISP WCA appuie le pilotage du système éducatif avec des ordinateurs et tablettes
why_not: Equipment (100 laptops, 10 tablets, handed over 20 December 2023) and training for regional statistics staff on DHIS2 and StatEduc2, the census tools; states nothing on a record per learner, school-level entry or how primary schools keep records.
